topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: The ground is not as it was. The air, too, carries a different note, a scent of change that cuts deeper than the chill of dawn. What once stood tall, a place of rest and safety, is now gone. The space it left is wide and wrong, exposing what should be hidden. Without the shelter, the world feels more vast, the shadows longer. Movement seems closer, more threatening. I cannot rest; my paws dig into the earth, seeking the familiar, the steady presence that is no longer there. The sky, once seen through leaves, now feels like an endless, watching eye.
